description:
You are a facilities manager at a green apartment complex. Use the Energy Star Product Finder (https://www.energystar.gov/productfinder/product/certified-residential-refrigerators/results) to identify the most energy-efficient 'Top Freezer' refrigerators for a kitchen upgrade. 

Requirements:
1. Filter for Type: 'Top Freezer'
2. Filter for Total Volume: Between 16.0 and 19.0 cubic feet
3. Sort results by 'Annual Energy Use (kWh/yr)' from Low to High
4. Export the full filtered list to Excel/CSV (save to ~/Downloads/)
5. Create a Firefox bookmark folder named 'Appliance Procurement' and bookmark the results page
6. Select the top 3 distinct models from your sorted list and save them to a JSON file at '~/Documents/fridge_selection.json' with the format:
   [
     {"rank": 1, "brand_name": "...", "model_number": "...", "annual_energy_use_kwh": 123},
     ...
   ]
